title: ExtraGlowOrigins
description: A datapack that adds various origins to the Extra Origins mod.
body:
This mod adds various origins for the Fabric mod called Extra Origins.\
Dwarf:\
\+ REALLY good miner.\
\+ Fits in 1 block gaps when crouching.\
\+ Has a tool belt.\
\- Slower.\
\- Agoraphobia.\
\
Faerie:\
\+ Can fly.\
\+- Same powers as inchling.\
\- Deals less melee damage.\
\- Unable to use shields.\
\- Weak arms.\
\- Can only wear light armor.\
\
Giant:\
\+ Can walk up full blocks.\
\+- Significantly larger than a human and have twice as much health.\
\- Exhausted faster.\
\- Takes more velocity damage.\
\
Bunnyman:\
\+ Can leap far.\
\+ Faster air movement.\
\+ Fits in 1 block gaps when crouching.\
\+ Can pluck carrots.\
\- Vegetarian.\
\- Fragile.\
\
Obsidian Golem:\
\+ Can teleport to the nether.\
\+ Can set spawn point in the nether.\
\+ Takes no knockback.\
\+ Has natural armor.\
\+ Takes no knockback.\
\+ Immune ot fire and explosions.\
\+ Takes 1 less damage from non piercing sources.\
\+- Does not gain effects from food.\
\- Slower.\
\- Unable to use shields.\
\- Exhausted faster.\
\- Gains significantly less hunger from food.
